mapper.select: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM e.occurred_at) AS int) AS iso_day_of_week, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM e.occurred_at) AS int) AS hour, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'OPEN') AS opens, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'CLICK') AS clicks FROM track_event e JOIN send_log s ON s.send_log_id = e.send_log_id WHERE e.bot_yn = 'N' AND s.kind = 'CAMPAIGN' AND e.occurred_at >= #{since} GROUP BY 1, 2
SELECT count(*) FROM send_log WHERE status = 'PENDING'
